combo_label: Sandwiches × Morris Dancing × 1066 and the Norman Conquest

entries.clue: Byname of Edward, the childless king whose death in January 1066 began it all
Steep earth mound of a timber castle, paired with a bailey below
Word for the distinct set of dances a particular village handed down
Thick-cut slab of bread, the sandwich a hungry builder asks for
Great survey of 1086, twenty years on, whose verdict was held to be beyond appeal
Browned outer edge children beg to have cut off their sandwiches
Circular ribbon badge, pinned to a dancer's hat or a prize bull
Boiled, mashed and spread between thin white slices at a tea party
Peppery seedling sprouts snipped into a dainty finger sandwich
Flexible spring metal, the stuff a rapper dancer's blade is made of
